description: Teams need to know when a code change silently breaks accessible names, labels, or descriptions on interactive elements.

include_description.description: When true, compare accessible descriptions in addition to accessible names and labels.

match_by_selector.description: When true, element matching prefers stable CSS-like selector identity when available; otherwise fallback matching is used.

new_dom_snippet.description: Required. Must contain a non-empty HTML or DOM fragment. Plain text is treated as literal markup input, not rendered content.

old_dom_snippet.description: Required. Must contain a non-empty HTML or DOM fragment. Plain text is treated as literal markup input, not rendered content.

show_element_paths.description: When true, output includes deterministic element path strings for matched and problematic nodes.

name: accessible-name-and-label-regression-diff
title: Accessible Name and Label Regression Diff
